themes.title: Anti-Immigration Targeting of Minorities
themes.blurb: Right-wing leaders in both the United States and Norway are doubling down on strict anti-immigration stances, framing assimilation and aggressive enforcement as essential for cultural preservation and national security. While Norway's FrP targets religious clan culture and integration taboos, US conservative coverage emphasizes noncitizen voting threats and efforts to strip citizenship.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Leader Sylvi Listhaug argues strict immigration policy protects integration from clan culture while calling out taboo 'shadow sides' of migration.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The administration and surrogates advance aggressive measures including prosecution threats over noncitizen voting and efforts to strip naturalized critics of citizenship.

themes.title: Rising Fuel Costs and Energy Inflation
themes.blurb: Right-wing political movements in Norway and the US are seizing on sharp increases in gas and fuel prices to attack incumbent government economic policy. Both groups connect energy inflation directly to tax policies and foreign policy disruptions, demanding immediate relief for consumers.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP highlights a 27.7% monthly fuel price surge following the expiration of tax cuts, pushing for government intervention.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: MAGA surrogates and voters focus heavily on high gas prices during town halls, linking energy costs to broader economic management.

themes.title: Geopolitical Debates Over Ukraine and Russia Policy
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures across borders are reacting to shifting policy stances on the war in Ukraine and sanctions against Russia. While Norwegian far-right leaders explicitly reaffirm commitment to NATO and Ukraine defense, US MAGA coverage focuses on Trump waiving sanctions and pursuing trade pragmatism with Moscow.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP leader Sylvi Listhaug explicitly affirms party commitment to Ukraine and NATO during the party convention.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Coverage centers on Trump waiving newly enacted Russia sanctions and arranging diesel import deals, provoking international debate.
